items.title: Phil Mead interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: probably the best concert I ever heard was J.J. Johnson, Tommy Flanagan, Tootie Heath, who was about 15 years old, and the cornet player was Nat Adderley.

ctx.x: Did Hamilton have a concert series while you were here that brought jazz musicians to campus?

Yes they did. And that was interesting. We had more bop musicians than Dixieland players at that time. In fact probably the best concert I ever heard was J.J. Johnson, Tommy Flanagan, Tootie Heath, who was about 15 years old, and the cornet player was Nat Adderley.
